description_full: Accelevation Holdings Corp. designs, manufactures, and installs power distribution and white space infrastructure products for mission-critical environments. Its products and services include infrastructure solutions, such as SkyBridge modular platform, techFrame steel structures and conveyance, thermal management products, and installation and maintenance services; and power products, such as remote power panels, including high-density remote power panels, as well as branch circuit whips, power distribution units and related monitoring, and upstream distribution products. The company serves hyperscaler, colocation, and data center customers. Accelevation Holdings Corp. was founded in 2017 and is based in Miamisburg, Ohio.

financial_summary: Accelevation Holdings Corp. is a mid-cap industrials business with a $2.9B market cap on $448M of annual revenue.

Returns on capital run at 1% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 32%.
The company is burning through $16M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, thin -5.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 6.8% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 90% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
